Acme Release Notes — v2.3.0

Date: 2026-04-12

New features
- Single sign-on with Okta
- Audit log export to CSV
- Optional dark mode

Bug fixes
- Fixed crash when uploading documents larger than 10MB
- Fixed timezone offset on the dashboard

Known issues
- Search may be slow on the first query after deploy
- Mobile layout has minor padding glitches on iOS Safari
